extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media outlets, and members of the press seeking Sandia news materials and contacts
extracted.subtask_description: A newsroom landing page listing media-relations resources for journalists covering Sandia National Laboratories: contact information, downloadable assets (b-roll, images, videos), background materials, subscription options, and expert-source requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide clear media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Contacts; News Media Help Line 505-844-4902; In New Mexico: Darrick Hurst 505-844-8009 drhurst@sandia.gov; In California: Michael Langley 925-294-1482 mlangle@sandia.gov; Contact Media Relations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List an overall news media help line plus regional media contacts with names, phone numbers, and email addresses so reporters can request information or interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer subscription options for news
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribe to News Releases; Subscribe to Lab News
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide subscription mechanisms so media and interested parties can receive news releases and lab news on an ongoing basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain accessible archive of news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: News Releases — View all news releases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep an organized, browsable archive of past news releases that reporters can search or reference when researching stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide background resources and fact sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Background Resources; Fact sheets; Sandia’s multimission work is represented in a diverse funding portfolio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply concise background materials and fact sheets describing missions, funding, centers, history, and other context reporters need to accurately portray stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supply downloadable B-roll with usage restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: B-Roll — Footage is provided for the sole use of media outlets for the purpose of news story illustration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer video B-roll for journalists, and state explicit usage rights/limitations (e.g., sole use by media outlets for news story illustration).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide high-quality images via Flickr
rubrics_metrics.description: Sandia on Flickr — Access hundreds of high quality images from the Sandia Labs photostream on Flickr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host or link to high-resolution images for press use and indicate where to access them (e.g., Flickr photostream).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide video assets on YouTube
rubrics_metrics.description: Videos — A collection of high quality videos available on YouTube highlighting the important work of Sandia Labs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make video content available on public channels (YouTube) for reporters to view and embed, with clear identification of purpose (highlighting work) and implied usage guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer expert-source requests and interview facilitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert Sources — Request an interview with a Sandia expert from AI to transportation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow reporters to request interviews with subject-matter experts across topical areas; provide a mechanism and point of contact for arranging expert comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlight publications and accomplishments for context
rubrics_metrics.description: Publications; Labs Accomplishments; Sandia Research magazine; Lab News
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present recent publications, lab accomplishments, and internal news magazines as reporting resources that demonstrate institutional activities and achievements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarize economic impact and institutional role
rubrics_metrics.description: Economic Impact — Sandia National Laboratories has a robust and widespread economic impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide high-level summaries of economic impact and institutional roles that journalists can cite to contextualize stories about the lab's activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide newsroom contact points for varied media needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Center; Newsroom; Background Resources; Social Media — Connect with Sandia on a variety of social media networks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer a central media center or newsroom hub that aggregates contacts, assets, backgrounders, and social channels to streamline journalists' access to materials and updates.
